commentary_title: Weak tonnage demand weighs on Aframax rates
commentary_summary: The tonne-miles index saw a decline in week 16, ending the week at 119.7 points. There was softer demand for Aframax vessels last week which pushed down rates on most routes. | Market activity was balanced in the Med and UKC regions with freight rates starting strong in week 16. Despite tonnage demand being weaker by the end of the week, rates still remained firm. | Next week is likely to remain a slow week with vessels sailing at lower speeds. Tonnage underway is also likely to remain muted.
